summary: This study is testing the combination of two drugs, vicadrostat and empagliflozin, in adults with type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and cardiovascular disease. Cardiovascular disease refers to conditions affecting the heart and blood vessels. A placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the study drug, is used for comparison. Boehringer Ingelheim is sponsoring this Phase 3 trial, which aims to enroll 11800 participants and is currently Recruiting.
